meta_title: SPL Locksmith & Secure | Emergency Locksmith Manchester
meta_description: SPL Locksmith & Secure in Manchester offers emergency lockouts, lock repairs, and security solutions. Fast response, fully trained locksmiths. Call 07451 261378.
hero_subhead: We'll get you back inside within the hour. No damage to your door, no drama—just swift, professional help.
services_heading: Locksmith & Security Services Across Greater Manchester
services_subhead: From emergency lockouts to full security upgrades, we handle residential and commercial locks with skill and speed.

services.title: Emergency Lockouts
services.desc: Locked yourself out? We arrive quickly and open your door without forcing it. Available 24/7, including weekends and bank holidays.

services.title: Lock Repairs & Replacement
services.desc: Broken locks, sticking mechanisms, or worn cylinders—we repair or replace with quality locks fitted to your exact needs.

services.title: Snap Lock & Cylinder Changes
services.desc: Increase security after a break-in or lost keys. We swap cylinders and fit upgraded locks to keep your home or business safer.

services.title: Upvc & Composite Door Locks
services.desc: Modern doors need specialist care. We repair and upgrade multipoint locks, handles, and hinges without damage.

services.title: Commercial Lock Installation
services.desc: Secure your business with professional-grade locks, master systems, and access control fitting. Bespoke solutions for offices, shops, and warehouses.

services.title: Security Surveys & Advice
services.desc: We assess your home or business and recommend locks and security upgrades tailored to actual risk. Peace of mind at a fair price.

about_pullquote: A locked door should never keep you stuck. We make it right, fast.
about_para_1: SPL Locksmith & Secure has served Manchester and the surrounding areas for nearly two decades. We started because we were frustrated by locksmiths who dragged their feet or charged over the odds. Our team is trained in all lock types—from traditional Yale locks to the latest multipoint systems—and we carry a full van of spares so most jobs are sorted on your first visit.
about_para_2: We've built our reputation on honesty and speed. Whether you're locked out at 3am or planning a security upgrade, you get the same calm, professional approach. Our customers come back because we do what we say, charge fairly, and don't judge. We're not the cheapest—but we're reliable, and that's worth more when your home's security is on the line.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Got locked out on a Friday night with no spare key anywhere. Called SPL and they were here in less than an hour. Opened the door cleanly, no forcing, no damage. Brilliant service and fair price. Would definitely call again.
reviews.author: Mike T.

reviews.text: Had my upvc door lock repaired. The lad who came was really knowledgeable, explained what was wrong, and fixed it properly. Didn't try to sell me unnecessary stuff. That's rare these days. Very happy.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Called them out for a commercial job at our office in town. They surveyed the building, gave us proper advice on security, and fitted new locks and handles throughout. Professional outfit, turned up on time, cleared up after themselves. Will be using them again.
reviews.author: David R.
